subtitle: A wild Atlantic surf beach on the Castlemartin peninsula, backed by a live tank-firing range West Germany's army used for 35 years.
spike_statement: West Germany fired live tank rounds on the Castlemartin range behind this beach from 1961 to 1996, a NATO deal that outlasted most of the Cold War.

levers.photo_tone: Gunmetal Atlantic swell under low cloud, khaki-green dune grass, red sandstone headland — no warm color, all weather and grit
